title: Solarpolis
tagline: A procedural 3D future, a thousand years out — starting inside a mature O'Neill cylinder in Earth orbit.
description:
A detailed 3D simulation set about 1000 years from now, starting inside a mature O'Neill cylinder in Earth orbit. Everything is procedural: the cylinder is a parametric blueprint, not a fixed model — its Rings, rivers, waterfalls and lakes are generated from the blueprint.

Work in progress, built on WebGPU; open it in a recent Chrome or Edge.
